title: Workflow transition targets a state not listed in the workflow's states
body: A workflow transition's `to` (or `from`) references a state that isn't in the workflow's `states` array. Fix: either add the target state to `states` (and to `terminalStates` if it's an end state), or change the transition's `to`/`from` to one of the declared states. Every state named by any transition must appear in `states`; `startState` and each of `terminalStates` must too.
fix: Add the target state to states[] (and terminalStates[] if terminal), or point the transition's to/from at an already-declared state.
